description: Records a vendor's bill the business still has to pay, as a draft bill: vendor, bill date, due date, lines, taxes and total. When the user gives a photo or PDF of a receipt or bill, read it yourself and pass what is printed: the vendor, date, each line, each tax and the total. When you can read the file's actual bytes (a file you were given by path or as an attachment your tools can open), also pass them as fileBase64 so the photo is attached to the draft (JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, AVIF, HEIC or PDF, at most 10 MB). Never write base64 from what you see in an image; without the real file, leave fileBase64 out and tell the user to attach the photo to the draft in the app. It is created as a DRAFT: nothing is posted, paid or sent. Tell the user it is waiting for them in Mobile Accounting (openInApp).

bookId.description: The set of books, from list_books.

currency.description: ISO currency when not the books' own.

fileBase64.description: The bill file itself, base64 (optional; only the file's real bytes).

category.description: Or a category name, matched exactly (optional).

description.description: What it was for (for example "Printer paper").

notes.description: A note for the person who reviews it.

taxes.description: Each tax printed on the bill.

label.description: The tax as printed (GST, HST, PST, QST, VAT, sales tax...).

total.description: The bill total, to check the lines and taxes add up.

vendor.description: The vendor (supplier), as printed on the bill.

name: record_bill
title: Record a bill (draft)
